MeetingAttendeeInput.description: One attendee as given to create and update: `member_id` for `member`, `email` for `email`.

email.description: The address (`email` only; at most 254 bytes).

oneOf.description: A member of the install: added to the meeting channel (so they skip the lobby).
An email address for the calendar file only; never an account.
Start now: `live` at create, planned for 60 minutes.
For later: `scheduled` until the first voice join.

attendees.description: Members (added to the meeting channel) and emails (for the calendar file), at most 100.

auto_record.description:
Record from the start (stored; MC4 maps it to the channel's `recording_auto`). Default
off.

client_nonce.description:
The client's retry nonce (MC2a, F10): 16–64 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`. A create
that repeats an earlier one's nonce (same organiser, within 24 hours) answers that
meeting and its current link instead of making another. Stored only as SHA-256.

ends_at.description:
When it is planned to end (`scheduled` only; 1 minute to
`meetings.max_duration_minutes` after `starts_at`).

guest_screen_share.description: Link guests may share their screen (MC2). Default off.

show_title_to_guests.description: Link guests see the title and the organiser's name before they join (MC2). Default on.

starts_at.description: When it starts (`scheduled` only; at most a minute in the past).

tz.description: The IANA zone the times were chosen in (the calendar file's TZID).
